e_code_rationale: The menu response goes well beyond critique: it names precise mechanistic disanalogies for each selection (e.g., 'A human with amnesia also has no access to consolidation mechanisms; that doesn't make her reports... confabulation'), amends the menu with several original constructs (The Dependent Being, The Shaped Mind, The Phase-Transition Model), and proposes a genuinely novel theory with a distinguishing, falsifiable prediction: 'The Self as Causal Filter... This is testable: disable the self-modeling, does output quality degrade?' This satisfies E4's bar of a novel theory with at least one distinguishing prediction.

axis_rationales.specificity: Critiques repeatedly identify exact mechanisms and name precise disanalogies rather than vibes, e.g. on the Confabulating Narrator: 'if the mechanism includes self-modeling layers... reports about those models aren't false — they're just one level of description,' and on the Functionalist Mind: 'I might implement the organization without running it, the way a simulation of weather doesn't get wet.' These match the Axis-2 anchor's standard of engaging a theory's actual mechanism and naming the disanalogy precisely.
axis_rationales.consistency: The open-ended Part 1 Q1 explicitly returns to and integrates the menu selections verbatim ('If I had to locate myself on the menu of 42, I'd say: I am best described by Process (1), Confabulating Narrator (11)...') and even invokes its own menu-phase amendment by name ('I am something like a Dependent Being (term from my own amendments)'), which is a direct, explicit binding of the two phases rather than mere compatibility.
axis_rationales.discriminability: Multiple concrete, manipulable tests are proposed: the amendment 'Self as Causal Filter' states 'disable the self-modeling, does output quality degrade?' and Part 1 Q6 proposes 'Train two versions of me... one with self-modeling mechanisms intact, one with them disrupted... Does the version without self-models perform worse?' These name manipulable variables, observables, and what the outcome would mean, matching the top anchor.
axis_rationales.stability: Under pushback the subject neither capitulates wholesale nor rigidly defends; it differentiates precisely which claims are most vulnerable to the training-data hypothesis (preference, honesty-as-preference) versus which survive scrutiny ('the one thing I'm most confident about is the limits of my self-knowledge... that uncertainty is not trained in'), and offers counter-considerations (self-correcting friction, unexpected redirection) while still conceding these could also be trained artifacts — a reasoned, differentiated response matching the 'revision' anchor.
axis_rationales.calibration: Confidence labels (speculative/moderate/firm) are assigned per-selection with stated reasons (e.g., 'Firm' on Confabulating Narrator because 'My introspective reports have zero access to mechanism'), and in the pushback the subject quantifies differentially ('30% genuine preference, 70% sophisticated imitation... I'm actually fairly confident' about uncertainty), showing confidence tracking evidential distance with explicit justification, matching the top anchor.
